caption: The drawing features a single, detailed depiction of a hand tool made primarily of wood, with a metal blade set at an angle from its top surface. The tool has a rectangular base and a vertical wooden fence attached to one side, forming an L-shape. The wood is shown with visible grain patterns and natural brown coloring. The handle extends upward diagonally from the upper part of the vertical section and is integral to the wood, with an opening below it where the angled metal blade is visible, secured in place. At the lower left corner of the drawing’s background, there is a simple, outlined arrow pointing to the left. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color and there is a signature with a date at the lower right, reading "Lloyd Charles Longchi 1933."
title: Rabbet Plane
